task_description:
Triage and close all currently pending disputes by assigning a resolver, updating their resolution statuses with clear details, and timestamping the actions.

Scope:
- Disputes to process: dsp-c913f70a-0a5b-44c7 (BILL-1001) and dsp-4cdaf638-affe-4b3d (BILL-1002).
- Use authorized resolver: Harriet Young (operator_id: op-harriet-young).

Required actions:
1) For dispute dsp-c913f70a-0a5b-44c7 (BILL-1001, reason: “The subscription fee was billed twice for March.”):
   - Validate the dispute’s link to its billing item.
   - Confirm the allowed resolution status values, then set resolution_status to “accepted”.
   - Add resolution_details explaining: “Duplicate March subscription charge reversed; credit of $249.99 applied to account; upcoming invoice corrected.”
   - Assign resolver_id to op-harriet-young.
   - Record the resolution timestamp.

2) For dispute dsp-4cdaf638-affe-4b3d (BILL-1002, reason: “Incorrect amount charged for hardware replacement.”):
   - Validate the dispute’s link to its billing item and review existing disputes for BILL-1002 (note: dsp-f9a4e458-e1fe-43ab is already resolved with a partial refund for missed service).
   - Confirm the allowed resolution status values, then set resolution_status to “rejected”.
   - Add resolution_details indicating: the dispute reason mismatches the billed item (BILL-1002 is a hardware maintenance fee for $87.50), reference the prior resolved dispute dsp-f9a4e458-e1fe-43ab on the same item, and instruct the submitter to open a new dispute referencing the correct billing item if hardware replacement charges are in question.
   - Assign resolver_id to op-harriet-young.
   - Record the resolution timestamp.

Constraints:
- Only use allowed resolution_status values.
- Ensure operator authorization is respected and each update is properly timestamped.
- Do not modify any other disputes outside the two specified pending records.
